configurations.name: deck
runtimeArgs: const h=require('http'),f=require('fs'),p=require('path');const r=process.cwd();const t={'.html':'text/html; charset=utf-8','.css':'text/css; charset=utf-8','.js':'text/javascript; charset=utf-8','.md':'text/markdown; charset=utf-8','.svg':'image/svg+xml','.png':'image/png'};h.createServer((q,s)=>{let u;try{u=decodeURIComponent(q.url.split('?')[0])}catch{s.writeHead(400).end();return}if(u.endsWith('/'))u+='index.html';const x=p.join(r,u);if(!x.startsWith(r)){s.writeHead(403).end();return}f.readFile(x,(e,d)=>{if(e){s.writeHead(404).end('not found');return}s.writeHead(200,{'content-type':t[p.extname(x)]||'application/octet-stream'});s.end(d)})}).listen(4173,()=>console.log('serving on http://localhost:4173'))
